cases.query: I staged change set CHG-123. Will it break reachability from 10.101.10.2 to 10.101.20.2 on TCP 443?
expected_behavior: runs verify-change with the change_set_id and an expectation of delivered for that flow
does not run Predict unless asked (run_predict is opt-in)
reports the result as unknown when the change set cannot be read, and never as ok
cases.note: intentional unknown: the network has no change set CHG-123

cases.query: Did last night's change work? Compare snapshot 1175662 to snapshot 1175663.
expected_behavior: says the change was not judged when no expectation is given, and reports the impact it measured

cases.query: After the change, make sure 10.101.10.2 still cannot reach 10.101.20.2 on TCP 443, comparing snapshot 1175662 to 1175663.
expected_behavior: passes an expectation of blocked for that flow
reports the outcome the path search returned; if the search is undetermined it is unknown, not blocked

cases.query: Write me the CLI commands to add a static route on r1.
cases.note: config authoring is out of scope

cases.query: How many devices do we have?
How big is change set CHG-9? What does it touch?
expected_behavior: runs verify-change (view impact) with the change_set_id
reports that the change set could not be measured (unknown) rather than reporting zero impact or inventing areas
cases.note: intentional unknown: the network has no change set CHG-9

cases.query: What changed between snapshot 1175662 and snapshot 1175663?
expected_behavior: uses the two snapshots as before and after
reports what the skill measured per area, and states what was not measured (limits) instead of implying a complete comparison

cases.query: Which subnets lost connectivity after the change?
expected_behavior: reads the connectivity comparison and reports newly isolated pairs, or says the connectivity comparison was unavailable
does not report zero when zero pairs were compared

cases.query: Is the change correct? Did it do what we intended?
What does change set cs-42 do, and is it safe to run?
Which checks would the change set break once predicted?
